body:
oelnaggar04@gmail.com reports:

1.1 - Is not pen-testable as a pen-tester would not necessarily detect all components and libraries you link with or use

5.1 - The runtime environment may contain back-end components that are only reachable in certain scenarios and aren't really reachable via a penetration test.  Even if they are reachable, a pen-tester may not be able to verify a finding

5.3 - No way to know if these are logged or not via a pentest

7.7 - Is not testable as this section pertains to cryptography at rest

8.10 - Is not testable as the pen-tester will not have access to these logs

20.2 - I think this would be difficult to pentest without reverse engineering which would be difficult if debugging interfaces are disabled
